objective: Complete an aligned non-oracle development meta-panel from registered same-contract studies, fit a fixed-split gated method-score policy without LOOCV, evaluate nonzero personalisation coverage and regret improvement on a held-out real study, then open a third untouched study under a public lock.

we_claim_if_success: An aligned nine-method non-oracle development meta-panel exists with at least two studies and the registered minimum unit/method availability.

A gated personalised policy selected only from development features and development outcomes can achieve nonzero coverage and lower deployed regret than always-global on one held-out real biological study under a fixed split.
A third untouched study is registered before outcome access for sequential confirmation.
we_do_not_claim: Universal personalised superiority across assays and organs
Prospective sealing of the held-out study when outcomes were already unsealed for descriptive SOTA (report as fixed-split real-biology evaluation)
Transport of spatial-region ARI to cell-type labels

development_meta_panel.same_mask_rule: Within each study use the strict nine-method complete unit mask. Do not impute missing method scores.

label_free_features.aggregation: For multi-section patients, mean features over available sections.

policy.calibration_rule: Never use the outer held-out unit (or held-out study) for fitting, scaling, global-default selection, or gate choice.
policy.selection_rule: Among thresholds with calibration coverage >= minimum_coverage and mean regret difference <= 0, choose the safest gate: lowest mean regret difference, then highest coverage, then highest threshold. Prefer 1-NN over 3-NN over ridge.

endpoints.coverage: fraction of held-out units with personalised_set (method != training global default)
endpoints.mean_regret_difference: deployed regret minus always-global regret (negative is better)
endpoints.bootstrap: percentile 95% CI, 10000 resamples of held-out units, seed 20260801
endpoints.personalized_value_success: coverage >= 0.25, mean_regret_difference < 0, and upper 95% CI of the difference < 0

nested_leave_one_unit_out.description: Primary real-biology personalisation endpoint. Outer loop holds out one independent donor/patient unit; inner leave-one-unit-out on the remaining units chooses the gain gate. Uses the aligned HER2ST+CRC non-oracle panel only.

cross_study_fixed_split.description: Harder transport test: train on one study, test on the other. Secondary; may remain fail-closed.

untouched_third_study.description: After meta-panel completion and policy freeze from HER2ST+CRC nested LOUO, open a third study without outcome access.

candidate.note: Three DLPFC donors as sequential confirmation only if independence from frozen v5 policy artefacts is documented. Prefer a fully external public cohort when available.
